compiled_state.title: [CLAUDE.md]: rule 23 exception clause violates Architectural Invariants 2(d) bloat criteria -> 4-line rule with embedded edge-case reduces readability
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Source
PR #72 llm-review run 25537710859, finding F5 (severity: minor, maintainability).

### Expected Behavior
Per CLAUDE.md Architectural Invariants rule 2(d): 'Verbose examples inside rules — rules should state the rule in one sentence plus one short clarifier; move long examples to the referenced doc.'

### Actual Behavior
CLAUDE.md Never Do These rule 23 (added by fadc-6b5d fix in PR #72) is 4 lines: the rule + a clarifier sentence + a one-sentence pipeline-handles description + a multi-clause Exception describing 'when merge-to-main.sh itself is broken in the cached plugin version' as an authorized bypass. The exception clause embeds a workflow edge case in a core rule.

### Suggested Fix
Reduce rule 23 to one sentence + one clarifier; move the cached-plugin-broken exception to a referenced doc (e.g., plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md or a new ADR / playbook section). Final rule 23 should look like:

```
23. **Never use direct `gh pr create` / `gh pr merge` / `git push` to create or update a PR** — always route through `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh`. Bug fadc-6b5d. Cached-plugin-broken exception: see <doc>.
```

### Severity
P4: cosmetic / style. The rule still works as written; refactor improves CLAUDE.md readability and aligns with its own bloat criteria.

### Origin
Follow-up from PR #72.
